sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Climbing Pomni are simple yet incredibly addictive. You'll start by controlling your climber as they navigate through a series of increasingly difficult levels. The goal is to climb to the top of each level while collecting coins and avoiding obstacles. You can use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move your climber left or right, jump, and grab onto handles to climb up or down.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter more obstacles, such as moving platforms, spiky walls, and falling rocks. You'll need to time your jumps and grabs perfectly to avoid taking damage and losing coins. The game also features a variety of coins and power-ups that you can collect to give you an edge over your opponents.

One of the unique features of Climbing Pomni is its focus on climbing mechanics. You can climb up or down walls, jump across gaps, and use your environment to your advantage. This adds a new level of depth to the game, making it feel more like a true climbing experience.

The game also features a variety of level types, including ice levels, fire levels, and even levels with moving platforms. Each level type requires a different approach, making the game feel fresh and exciting every time you play.
